protocol.selection: Validation log loss on identical context-eligible shots; no test-based retuning
protocol.primary_contrast: context versus geometry, both fitted on same eligible training shots
secondary_contrasts: selected family versus frozen original geometry
all-shot hybrid versus frozen original geometry
protocol.features: 8 geometric + 5 goalkeeper + 5 outfield-defender spatial features; no outcome, provider xG, body part, penalty flag, shot trajectory or impact height
protocol.geometry_control: Retain all original geometric feature values and original match split
protocol.calibration: No additional calibrator; evaluate reliability, Brier score and ECE on held-out-from-fitting matches
protocol.context_policy: Exactly one opponent goalkeeper and at least one outfield defender with finite coordinates; shot strictly in front of goal line
protocol.fallback: Existing frozen geometry teacher for missing context; SkillCorner also falls back outside min/max selected-feature range on eligible StatsBomb training shots
protocol.skillcorner_alignment: Event endpoint geometry is already attack-normalized; rotate tracking only; exact frame_end-1; observed shooter, ball and GK required; shooter-ball and event-tracked shooter distances <=4m; endpoint matched
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-match bootstrap resamples; descriptive conditional on fitted models, no source-domain shift uncertainty
protocol.test_status: Same held-out-from-fitting matches used in prior geometry analysis; exploratory extension, not a new untouched test
protocol.missingness_audit: 195 context-ineligible corpus shots include 143 goals; report selection bias and full-population hybrid metrics
protocol.transfer_status: Experimental teacher predictions; no SkillCorner probability validation yet

limitations: Test matches held out from fitting but previously examined for geometry research.
Freeze-frame coverage and shot timing differ from SkillCorner tracking.
No body part, verified penalty type, measured impact height or post-shot information.
StatsBomb coordinates mapped to a nominal 105 x 68 m pitch.
This test does not establish SkillCorner calibration or tactical intervention effects.

skillcorner_transfer.source: Experimental hybrid estimated xG; not official StatsBomb or SkillCorner xG
skillcorner_transfer.status: Transfer coverage and feature shift audited; SkillCorner probability calibration remains unverified
skillcorner_transfer.fallback_policy: Frozen geometric teacher if context is absent, misaligned or outside selected feature min/max on StatsBomb training shots; bounds are not a calibration guarantee

source_coverage.interpretation: Penalty flags are absent on these SkillCorner shot rows; that does not establish that penalties are absent or correctly covered.
